items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: We did some stuff of Frank’s writing and a one by Norman Simmons and also Joe Cohn, Al Cohn’s son was on that... That’s a wonderful CD.

ctx.x: Yeah. Some people feel that, well because the venues have changed so much, that there’s just not the places that the talent can be incubated. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

Well I find that where there’s a will there’s a way, and that’s the truth. Oh I didn’t mention another great group, a privilege I had of playing with was Frank Wess, who is another fabulous musician of the Basie alumni. And we did a wonderful thing over in Norway, in Oslo. He did a nice recording over there. It’s called “Surprise, Surprise.” We did some stuff of Frank’s writing and a one by Norman Simmons and also Joe Cohn, Al Cohn’s son was on that, and Lynn Seaton. That’s a wonderful CD. And we did some nice…
All right. Thank you very much on behalf of Hamilton College. It’s been a real pleasure.
